== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Fire Extinguisher (Japanese)|Fire Extinguisher]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/sputman1021/imagegallery/47850 Japanese A New Hope PSA showcase], PSA certificate 161939296.

Crop rectangle <code>(147, 606, 1313, 2236)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>bc8dfb3da685851ab33b2713c69641b7d62ad2b6b94adba0f191b714317ca9fc</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
